tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)(i)
units.summary: Identify the element forming a 1- ion with the electron configuration of helium.

units.label: 1(a)(ii)
units.summary: Identify the element with the highest first ionisation energy.

units.label: 1(a)(iii)
units.summary: Identify the Period 3 element from four successive ionisation energies.
units.difficulty_basis: Interpret large jump after second ionisation

units.label: 1(a)(iv)
units.summary: Identify the element forming an octahedral fluoride molecule.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs shape reasoning for six electron pairs

units.label: 1(a)(v)
units.summary: Identify an element that reacts with water to form an acidic solution.

units.label: 1(a)(vi)
units.summary: Identify element X from the molar mass of XH3 of 34.0.

units.label: 1(a)(vii)
units.summary: Identify an element forming a hydride in which it has oxidation number of -4.

units.label: 1(a)(viii)
units.summary: Identify the element from a gas density at room temperature and pressure.
units.difficulty_basis: Molar mass from density and molar volume

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: Explain the conductivity and melting point trends in Period 3 chlorides using bonding and structure.
units.difficulty_basis: 5-mark comparison covering ionic and molecular lattices

units.label: 2(a)(i)
units.summary: Plot volume of oxygen against time and find the rate at 500 s from a tangent.

units.label: 2(a)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the initial concentration of hydrogen peroxide from the final volume of oxygen.
units.difficulty_basis: Gas volume to concentration with stoichiometry

units.label: 2(b)
units.summary: Use electrode potentials to write an equation in which hydrogen peroxide acts as a reducing agent.

units.label: 2(c)(i)
units.summary: Write the equilibrium equation for the ligand substitution of cobalt(II) aqua ions with chloride ions.

units.label: 2(c)(ii)
units.summary: Explain the temperature-dependent colour changes and predict whether blue formation is exothermic or endothermic.
units.difficulty_basis: Le Chatelier reasoning in a complex ion context

units.label: 3(a)
units.summary: Draw 3-D structures of the two optical isomers of the iron(III) tris(ethanedioate) complex.
units.difficulty_basis: Bidentate ligand optical isomers with charge

units.label: 3(b)(i)
units.summary: State the end point colour change of a self-indicating cerium(IV) titration.
units.difficulty_basis: Colours of Ce4+ and Ce3+ in unfamiliar titration

units.label: 3(b)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the percentage by mass of ethanedioic acid in rhubarb from redox titration data.
units.difficulty_basis: Mean titre, scaling and significant figures

units.label: 4(a)(i)
units.summary: State the oxidation number of platinum in cis-platin.

units.label: 4(a)(ii)
units.summary: Outline the mechanism of ligand substitution forming cis-platin using curly arrows.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar mechanism at a metal centre

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Name the functional groups present in paracetamol.

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Describe a two-stage synthesis of paracetamol with mass of 4-nitrophenol, reagents and purification.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark synthesis with yield calculation and practical detail

units.label: 5(a)
units.summary: Calculate the enthalpy change of neutralisation from calorimetry data with a dibasic acid.

units.label: 5(b)(i)
units.summary: State a technique to determine the equilibrium amount of succinic acid.

units.label: 5(b)(ii)
units.summary: Write the equilibrium equation for esterification of succinic acid with ethanol.
units.difficulty_basis: Dibasic acid and two alcohol molecules

units.label: 5(b)(iii)
units.summary: Draw the skeletal formula of the diethyl ester of succinic acid.

units.label: 5(b)(iv)
units.summary: Explain why amounts in moles can be used in the Kc expression for this equilibrium.

units.label: 5(b)(v)
units.summary: Calculate Kc for the esterification from initial and equilibrium amounts.

units.label: 6(a)(i)
units.summary: Give the systematic name of compound A from the aldol reaction.

units.label: 6(a)(ii)
units.summary: State the type of reaction in which ethanal forms compound A.

units.label: 6(a)(iii)
units.summary: Complete the acid-base equilibrium with conjugate pairs for ethanal and hydroxide and write the second step.

units.label: 6(a)(iv)
units.summary: Draw the organic product of the analogous reaction of propanone with hydroxide.
units.difficulty_basis: Apply an unfamiliar reaction by analogy

units.label: 6(b)
units.summary: Explain the role of electrophiles using one aliphatic and one aromatic reaction with mechanisms.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark synoptic extended response with two mechanisms
